text:
Morgan: FYI nightly link-scan caught 2 dead anchors in /kb/runtime/troubleshooting.md and an external gist returning 410. tagging docs owners.
doc-bot: scan results -> dead anchors: troubleshooting.md#kv-cache (line 88), troubleshooting.md#batching-hint (line 154); external gist 410: https://gist.github.com/old/snippet-410. Will re-run after changes.
Priya: I can do the anchor quickfixes now. small sed and update anchor ids.
Devon: I can rehost the gist. do we prefer /static/gists/runtime-helpers.md or inline the snippet in the kb page?
Morgan: prefer gists in /static/gists for traceability. please add a brief frontmatter title and update link.
Priya: quick grep to confirm: ```rg "#kv-cache|#batching-hint" docs/kb/runtime/troubleshooting.md -n``` then edit anchors to be kebab-case and add explicit HTML anchors where needed. branch: fix/docs/runtime-anchors-493.
Devon: rehosted gist branch fix/docs/gist-rehost-493. uploaded file -> /static/gists/runtime-helpers.md and replaced external url in docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301 (WIP).
Sam: can someone add a tiny rendered snapshot test for the troubleshooting page? last time we had build flake when markdown had raw HTML anchor.
Priya: will add a snapshot in tests/pages-snapshots/troubleshooting.test.ts and ensure CI passes.
Morgan: cheers. please mention Linear ticket KB-801 in PR and add a short changelog entry.
Devon: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301 ready for review.
Priya: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1302 includes anchor fix + test.
Sam: will review after morning standup, quick LGTM if snapshots look good.
Morgan: thanks — once merged, doc-bot will pick up the re-run. ping here when merged and I'll mark KB-801 resolved. :white_check_mark:
